exceptions.rationale: Reviewed 2026-09-17 in packaging/docker/evidence/server-vulnerability-disposition-2026-09-17.md; explicit risk acceptance renews only this exact tuple through November 15. Trixie remains open/no-DSA minor. No call path to the deprecated DNS packet-printing/debug APIs was found; the normal resolver is not the affected path. Remove at the first supported trixie glibc containing the 2.43-3 fix or equivalent backport, or corrected scanner applicability.

Reviewed 2026-10-03: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-19499 still marks the installed Debian 13 package vulnerable. A fix in another Debian release is not a supported target update. Native dependencies remain present and indirect reachability is not dismissed. Remove this exact tuple at the first supported trixie fixed build or corrected applicability; reassess by expiry.
